description: Which works of a collection can be bought right now on the open market (the artist's own listings and collectors' resales), as the marketplace reports them: token, ask, expiry, the listing's order hash and protocol address, and for each work its Origin Passport, its record and its proof — plus the exact steps to check the work and fill the listing from your own wallet, and what holding a work earns (a free RUTHVEN Origin Passport for an artwork you own). Without a collection, lists the collections that have a market answer. RUTHVEN values nothing, recommends nothing and is not a party to any sale.
name: ruthven_for_sale
title: Works for sale
